page.overview:
What is Modular Buildings Collection?

Modular Buildings Collection is a sub-theme of Creator introduced in 2007, which features large, highly detailed, connectable buildings, primarily aimed at older teenage and adult fans of LEGO. To date there have been nine sets ranging from fire houses to town halls.

Each set costs around £100 GBP/$150 USD except for the more expensive 10224 Town Hall , 10243 Parisian Restaurant, and the 10th Anniversary 10255 Assembly Square and the cheaper 10182 Café Corner and 10190 Market Street.

The buildings are scaled to the minifigure, and therefore can be thought of as a more advanced version of City/Town
